apiKey.description: Yandex Cloud API key or IAM token. Falls back to YANDEX_API_KEY / YANDEX_IAM_TOKEN env vars.

folderId.description: Yandex Cloud folder ID. Required for IAM token auth. Falls back to YANDEX_FOLDER_ID env var.

voice.description: Voice name (e.g. alexander, marina, john). Default: ermil.

lang.description: Language code (e.g. ru-RU, en-US, kk-KK). Default: ru-RU.

role.description: Voice role / emotion: neutral, good, evil, friendly, strict, whisper.

format.description: Audio output format. Default: oggopus (ideal for Telegram voice bubbles).

authType.description: Auth mode. Auto-detected from token prefix if not set.
